nodes.label: bureauSerif Typography System
nodes.rationale: Weight 200 is anti-convention — most editorial sites use 300-400 for serif headlines. The extra-light whisper forces the serif to feel like quiet authority rather than declaration. Line-height pinned at 1.0 creates tight overlapping baselines that read as deliberately set. Tracking locked at -0.03em across all sizes.

nodes.label: Inter Typography System
nodes.rationale: Single weight (400) with no bold variant keeps the sans side neutral so the serif can dominate. Using only one weight makes Inter invisible, letting bureauSerif carry all hierarchy differentiation.

nodes.label: Paper Cream Canvas (#f2f1ed)
nodes.rationale: Warm off-white that distinguishes the brand from clinical SaaS whites. Pure white (#ffffff) is reserved for card surfaces only — the cream is the non-negotiable brand foundation that gives an editorial, parchment-like warmth.

nodes.label: Zero Chromatic Color Principle
nodes.rationale: 0% colorfulness detected in palette by design. Hierarchy is built entirely through scale, tracking, and serif/sans contrast rather than color. Adding blue, red, or green breaks the editorial register.

nodes.label: Shadow-Free Elevation Principle
nodes.rationale: No shadows anywhere. Structure is built through color contrast between cream canvas, white card surfaces, and black ink. Generous radius (24-32px) and whitespace define component boundaries rather than elevation or drop shadows.

nodes.label: Two-Font Two-Weight Typographic Contract
nodes.rationale: bureauSerif at 200 for display, Inter at 400 for everything else. By refusing to add weight variants, the serif's whisper-weight becomes the loudest thing on the page and the sans's neutrality becomes invisible. Emphasis comes only from font family switching, size stepping, and tracking adjustment.

nodes.label: Pill-Shaped Button Geometry
nodes.rationale: Fully pill-shaped (9999px radius) on a monochrome black button — the rounded geometry feels like a physical stamp pressed onto the cream page. All actions use pill radius; no sharp or subtly-rounded buttons exist in this system.
